PARAMS = {
    "Rf":     (500e3, 440e3, 650e3),    # feedback resistor sets Zt and Rf noise
    "Cf":     (0.3e-15, 0.1e-15, 5e-15),# optional bypass across Rf
    "I1":     (9e-6, 5e-6, 11e-6),      # gain-stage current
    "gmid1":  (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),       # NMOS gain device gm/Id
    "L1":     (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Isf":    (4e-6, 2.5e-6, 6e-6),     # PMOS follower current (sets pole with CL)
    "gmidsf": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "Lsf":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmidp":  (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),         # PMOS mirror family (low gm/Id -> low noise)
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Ip":     (1.5e-6, 1.0e-6, 3e-6),   # PMOS bias diode branch
}

def _vgs_solve(l, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
    for _ in range(30):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if abs(l.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd, cl = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13), spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    I1, Isf, Ip = p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Ip"]
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # NMOS CS gain device: DC vin = amp = Vgs1 (no DC current in Rf)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    vin = m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vin)
    vin = m1.vgs

    # PMOS follower, bulk tied to own source (no body effect): vout = vin + Vsg_sf
    msf = lut.size("p", p["gmidsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=1.0, vsb=0.0)
    vout = vin + msf.vgs
    msf = lut.size("p", p["gmidsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=vout, vsb=0.0)
    vout = vin + msf.vgs

    # bias network: IREF -> NMOS diode -> NMOS sink (Ip) -> PMOS diode -> PMOS sources
    mref = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    mpref = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=0.6)
    mpref = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=mpref.vgs)
    mnb = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, Ip, vds=VDD - mpref.vgs)
    mp1 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=VDD - vin)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Isf, vds=max(VDD - vout, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MPREF", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpref)
    n.dev("MP1", "amp", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("M1", "amp", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RF", "amp", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "amp", "iin", Cf)
    n.dev("MP2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp2)
    n.dev("MSF", "vss", "amp", "vout", "vout", msf)

    # ---- small-signal model (2-node nodal solve + follower pole)
    gout = m1.gds + mp1.gds
    Ca = m1.cdd + mp1.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.15 * msf.cgg + 3e-15
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cfe = Cf + m1.cgd
    gsf_out = msf.gm + msf.gds + mp2.gds
    Asf = msf.gm / gsf_out
    Csf = cl + mp2.cdd + msf.cdd
    wsf = gsf_out / Csf

    f = np.logspace(3, 9.5, 1500)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    G = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cfe
    Y00 = s * Cin + G
    Y10 = m1.gm - G
    Y11 = gout + s * Ca + G
    Y01 = -G
    det = Y00 * Y11 - Y01 * Y10
    zamp = -Y10 / det
    z = np.abs(zamp * Asf / (1 + s / wsf))
    z0 = z[0]
    idx = np.where(z < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]
    peak_db = 20 * math.log10(max(z) / z0)
    A = m1.gm / (gout + 1.0 / Rf)

    # noise at 1 MHz
    gamma = 0.8
    en2 = 4 * kT * gamma / m1.gm * (1 + mp1.gm / m1.gm)
    w1m = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (w1m * (Cin + Cfe)) ** 2
    power = 1.98 * (iref + Ip + I1 + Isf)

    # corner DC check of vout (diagnostic)
    vlo, vhi = 9.0, -9.0
    for c, t in (("ss", -40), ("ff", 125), ("tt", 27)):
        try:
            l = lut.at(c, t)
            vg1 = _vgs_solve(l, "n", m1.W, m1.L, I1, 0.6, 0.0)
            vgs = _vgs_solve(l, "p", msf.W, msf.L, Isf, 1.0, 0.0)
            vlo = min(vlo, vg1 + vgs); vhi = max(vhi, vg1 + vgs)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "vout_dc": vout,
        # diagnostics
        "A_loop": A, "peak_db": peak_db, "f_sf": wsf / (2 * PI),
        "vin": vin, "vout_corner_lo": vlo, "vout_corner_hi": vhi,
        "vsd_mp2_margin_1v62": (1.62 - vout) - mp2.vdsat,
    }
